title: P3 inbox_read: arguments
description: The built-in tool inbox_read is in tools/list only for an attempt whose type declared inbox.read (MSG-8). It returns entries from the worker inbox (if the role has one), the role inbox and the inboxes of the bot groups the worker is a member of, in number order; a repeat in the same attempt returns the same entries. The arguments have no tenant, inbox or worker.

types.description: Types from the task type's inbox.read; without the field, all such types.

max.description: How many entries to return, at most 20.
